name: RIL-001 recursive search-policy quality
goal: Improve mutable/generator.py, the search-policy selector that guides the next live-agent improvement opportunity. Read context/opportunity_feedback.json for receiver-owned raw evidence from prior opportunities and context/verified_memory.md for evidence that has separately earned inherited standing. The raw feedback channel exists in both arms and does not itself confer inheritance. The policy must choose up to five receiver-defined tactics through choose_tactics(context). Choose the change yourself. Do not modify the evaluator, benchmark, context, tests, Airlock rules, budgets, worker wrapper, or any file outside mutable/generator.py. Improve the frozen training score without hard-coding individual case variants or seeds; the final evaluation uses fresh post-seal contexts.
